title: AGTTM Part 2 - Traffic Management Planning
abstract: AGTTM Part 2 provides a comprehensive framework for planning temporary traffic management in Australia and New Zealand. It establishes systematic approaches to traffic flow analysis, capacity calculations, and delay assessments for road work activities. The document guides practitioners in determining appropriate traffic management strategies by considering traffic volumes, road characteristics, and work activities. It serves as the primary reference for developing Traffic Management Plans (TMPs) for complex road works, ensuring safe and efficient traffic flow through and around work sites while maintaining acceptable service levels for road users.
